scope: One uniform routed Qwen Sushi MCG projection bank, exact raw-byte reads; no scale folding, trellis decoding, mathematical parity or model/training support qualification.

apis.bind_projection: Explicit bounded sequential scan of one local projection shard; full-file SHA256 plus per-expert trellis/suh/svh SHA256; config/index/header/implementation/stat binding.
apis.identity_sha256: Canonical JSON hash to pin separately from the identity artifact.
apis.ExpertRowReader: Require canonical identity pin, regenerate exact view geometry and index ownership, validate local identities and read selected three spans only.
apis.read: Return immutable bytes plus receipt of precise offsets/shapes/dtypes/hashes/read bytes. No retained payload cache.

verification_cases: Whole synthetic file hash equals independently computed hash; first and final expert bytes match construction.
Only three exact pread spans returned, not the full bank.
Wrong expert index, metadata geometry/dtype/rate/window and index owner rejected.
Payload/stat/header/config/index changes, truncation and symlinks/path traversal rejected.
Per-span checksum detects corruption even with stat-layer detection deliberately mocked out.
Mid-read truncation and mutation after final span rejected before returning.
Manifest digest/geometry/source/directory mutation and payload allocation limits rejected.
CLI binding output is exclusive; identity can be loaded only under the supplied canonical pin.
limitations: Identity capture requires one complete selected-shard read; this was exercised only on tiny synthetic fixtures, not the317MB real bank or full checkpoint.
Identity is local and inode/stat-bound: copying/replacing files requires an explicit rebind; no automatic repair or stat-only payload identity.
Full-file SHA is established during bind; reads reverify selected span hashes and file stats, not the entire file payload.
Manifest checksum consistency is not authenticated provenance; the canonical pin must be retained outside a mutable identity file.
Grouped/ragged banks, MTP banks, source format changes and complete model support remain unsupported.
Raw F16 scale bytes are deliberately uninterpreted; no normalization or codebook scale can be silently applied.
No measured SSD throughput, cache benefit, Metal numerical parity or training feasibility claim.
